_comment: Warlock system-configurable v1 — ALL strategy parameters live here, loaded by bot.js at start via config-loader.js. No strategy number is hard-coded in bot.js anymore; change a profile here (or select another profile with WARLOCK_PROFILE) and restart — no rebuild. Sources: deep-analysis report §5.1–§5.8 (warlock-batches-1-2-deep-analysis-2026-11-26.md), D-0c Rev 2 halt table / Pilot Spec Rev 1, Batch 1/2 FROZEN-SPEC. Refuted rules are NOT in any profile as adopted values: no 20% fee/TVL gate, no age gates, no flat TP 7%, no FP buffer as adopted, no ft>=1.5% raise. Units are stated per field; fractions are 0..1 (0.20 = 20%), percents are points (13 = 13%).

_sources.h17: Deep-analysis §5.7 test #1 (H17 pump-cliff reject, two-batch directional, NOT confirmed)
_sources.halt: D-0c Rev 2 / Pilot Spec Rev 1 §3 (K1–K9, 5 SOL book / 1.25 SOL leg); paperHalt is the frozen paper-book safety rule, deep-analysis §5.5
_sources.stamps: Deep-analysis §5.6 items 1–12 (fields are stamped by shadow-stamps.js / paper-history.js; item 13, the 19–22 Nov reject universe, is unrecoverable)

e-baseline.description: E baseline (Batch 1 arm E, the only book clearing the frozen adoption bar): 0.6% FT floor, no age gates, no 20% gate, reshape-freeze-5, TP 13%, emergency TP 10%, SL+ 3%/0.1%, emergency stop -20%, $500/leg, max 2 concurrent on the 5 SOL pilot scale at 1.25 SOL/leg.

entrySync.note: §5.6 #12: entry synchronisation across books is NOT implemented; this flag exists so the next batch can switch it on and stamp syncGroup on open rows. Do not set true — no code reads it as an enable.

h17.description: H17 pump-cliff reject on top of the E baseline (deep-analysis §5.7 test #1, pre-registered forward test vs E as control): reject entries with pump24h >= +40% AND pump1h in [-20%, -5%]. Hypothesis — two-batch directional, NOT confirmed. Everything else is the E baseline.

paper-safety.description: Paper-book profile: the E baseline run on the Batch 1/2-style $1,000 paper books (max 10 positions/book, the parallel multi-book harness) with the frozen paper-book safety rule (§5.5) as the enforced halt. The live K1–K9 halt table still applies to the live path; this profile only changes paper sizing.
